Return findings [{statement,citation:{record_id,start_line,end_line,quote}}] and limitations.","passages":[{"record_id":"jufe-schedule-2026-10-11","start_line":60,"end_line":73,"lines":[{"line":60,"text":"1. **\"Evolution within the manifold is stochastically emergent\"** (line"},{"line":61,"text":"   13). **Checked directly, repository-wide**: the word \"stochastic\""},{"line":62,"text":"   (in any form) appears **nowhere else in the entire 26-file retained"},{"line":63,"text":"   collection**, and in **no prior report in `docs/reports/`** —"},{"line":64,"text":"   confirmed by direct search. The dedicated chapter that actually"},{"line":65,"text":"   analyses this mechanism (source-30 report, covering Path-Dependency,"},{"line":66,"text":"   the Hysteresis Operator, and the Emergence Operator) describes it in"},{"line":67,"text":"   explicitly deterministic, history-dependent terms — \"is"},{"line":68,"text":"   non-Markovian,\" \"a direct result of its previous path\" (source 30,"},{"line":69,"text":"   line 11) — with no probability distribution, random variable, or"},{"line":70,"text":"   stochastic-process formalism anywhere in that file or its analysis."},{"line":71,"text":"   **This is a concrete claim made only in the abstract, not stated,"},{"line":72,"text":"   defined, or supported by the dedicated chapter covering the same"},{"line":73,"text":"   mechanism.** Not previously flagged by any report."}]},{"record_id":"jufe-schedule-2026-10-11","start_line":74,"end_line":85,"lines":[{"line":74,"text":"2. **\"Sympathetic weights (`\\omega_\\alpha`)\"** (line 11). The symbol"},{"line":75,"text":"   `\\omega_\\alpha` is covered (above), but **the adjective \"sympathetic\""},{"line":76,"text":"   applied to it here is not used by either source 8 or source 11/12**"},{"line":77,"text":"   (both call it \"the dynamic weight\"/\"weighting,\" never \"sympathetic\")."},{"line":78,"text":"   \"Sympathetic\" is already an established, *different* vocabulary"},{"line":79,"text":"   thread elsewhere in the collection — \"sympathetic gear shifts\""},{"line":80,"text":"   (`\\hat{\\mathcal{S}}_y`, sources 11/12 and 32's Proof 2) and"},{"line":81,"text":"   \"sympathetic modulation\" of `\\delta G_k` (source 26) — neither of"},{"line":82,"text":"   which is `\\omega_\\alpha`. **Whether the abstract's \"sympathetic"},{"line":83,"text":"   weights\" is simply an informal gloss for `\\omega_\\alpha`, or implies"},{"line":84,"text":"   an unstated connection to the `\\hat{\\mathcal{S}}_y}`/`G_k`"},{"line":85,"text":"   \"sympathetic\" operators, is not addressed by any existing report.**"}]},{"record_id":"jufe-coverage-2026-10-11","start_line":50,"end_line":50,"lines":[{"line":50,"text":"| 17 | `35.md` | `.../CANONICAL/TFJ-Shunt-Radiation-Equivalence-in-Magnon-Systems.md` | **None** | Reading plan §3 names it as a scheduled \"application,\" no content-level check performed by any report | **Verified directly for this audit**: introduces a previously-uncatalogued operator, the \"Shunt-Radiation Equivalence\" (`\\hat{\\mathcal{S}}_R`, line 7), and a strong, unassessed claim of \"laboratory-verified physics\"/empirical proof-of-principle (line 19) tied to a named external experiment (UCCS/RPTU magnon data) — none of this has been checked against any other source or against the claimed experimental basis |"}]}]}
